# Convergence Issues and Outliers Statistics

```{r}
#| label: conv-table
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# STUDY 1: convergence & outliers summary (APA Style - landscape with longtable)
create_apa_convergence_table_study1 <- function(results_df) {
  results_df %>%
    filter(Parameter == "eta1") %>%
    select(
      Condition,
      Method,
      Model,
      Distr_Exo,
      Distr_Epsilon,
      Distr_Zeta,
      SampleSize,
      Reliability,
      N_Converged_This_Method,
      Convergence_Rate_This_Method,
      N_After_Global_Convergence,
      N_Outliers_This_Method,
      Outlier_Rate_This_Method,
      N_Final
    ) %>%
    rename(Distribution = Distr_Exo) %>%
    mutate(
      Distribution = case_when(
        Distribution == "nonnormal" ~ "Right-skewed",
        Distribution == "normal" ~ "Normal",
        Distribution == "uniform" ~ "Uniform",
        TRUE ~ Distribution
      ),
      Distr_Epsilon = case_when(
        Distr_Epsilon == "exp.rate1" ~ "Right-skewed",
        Distr_Epsilon == "normal" ~ "Normal",
        TRUE ~ Distr_Epsilon
      ),
      Distr_Zeta = case_when(
        Distr_Zeta == "exp.rate1" ~ "Right-skewed",
        Distr_Zeta == "normal" ~ "Normal",
        TRUE ~ Distr_Zeta
      ),
      Convergence_Rate_This_Method = round(Convergence_Rate_This_Method, 1),
      Outlier_Rate_This_Method = round(Outlier_Rate_This_Method, 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Condition, factor(Model, levels = c("Full", "Linear")), Method)
}

# table
conv_table_study1 <- create_apa_convergence_table_study1(results_study_1)

tab_caption_study1 <- "Convergence and Outlier Statistics (Simulation 1)"
tab_note_study1 <- "Distr. = distribution of exogenous latent variables. Epsilon = distribution of measurement errors. Zeta = distribution of structural disturbances. N Conv. = number of replications that converged for this method. Conv. Rate = percentage of replications that converged (%). N Global Conv. = sample size after entire non-convergent replications across approaches excluded. N Outliers = number of outliers detected for this method. Outlier Rate = percentage of converged cases flagged as outliers (%). N Final = final sample size after global outlier removal across methods."

kableExtra::kbl(
  conv_table_study1,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "r", "r",
            "r", "r", "r",
            "r", "r",
            "r"),
  col.names = c("Cond.", "Method", "Model", "Distr.", "Epsilon", "Zeta", "N", "Rel.",
                "N Conv.", "Conv. Rate", "N Global Conv.",
                "N Outliers", "Outlier Rate", "N Final"),
  caption = tab_caption_study1,
  linesep = ""
) %>%
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(
    " " = 8,
    "Convergence" = 3,
    "Outliers" = 3
  )) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header", "scale_down"),
    font_size = 6,
    position = "left"
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top", latex_hline = "major") %>%
  kableExtra::footnote(
    general = tab_note_study1,
    general_title = "Note.",
    threeparttable = TRUE,
    escape = TRUE)
  #) %>%
  #kableExtra::landscape()


# STUDY 2: convergence & outliers summary (APA Style - landscape with longtable)
create_apa_convergence_table_study2 <- function(results_df, equation = "eta4") {
  param <- ifelse(equation == "eta4", "eta1", "eta4")

  results_df %>%
    filter(
      Equation == equation,
      Parameter == param
    ) %>%
    select(
      Condition,
      Method,
      Model,
      Distr_Exo,
      Distr_Epsilon,
      Distr_Zeta,
      SampleSize,
      Reliability,
      N_Converged_This_Method,
      Convergence_Rate_This_Method,
      N_After_Global_Convergence,
      N_Outliers_This_Method,
      Outlier_Rate_This_Method,
      N_Final
    ) %>%
    rename(Distribution = Distr_Exo) %>%
    mutate(
      Distribution = case_when(
        Distribution == "nonnormal" ~ "Right-skewed",
        Distribution == "normal" ~ "Normal",
        Distribution == "uniform" ~ "Uniform",
        TRUE ~ Distribution
      ),
      Distr_Epsilon = case_when(
        Distr_Epsilon == "exp.rate1" ~ "Right-skewed",
        Distr_Epsilon == "normal" ~ "Normal",
        TRUE ~ Distr_Epsilon
      ),
      Distr_Zeta = case_when(
        Distr_Zeta == "exp.rate1" ~ "Right-skewed",
        Distr_Zeta == "normal" ~ "Normal",
        TRUE ~ Distr_Zeta
      ),
      Convergence_Rate_This_Method = round(Convergence_Rate_This_Method, 1),
      Outlier_Rate_This_Method = round(Outlier_Rate_This_Method, 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Condition, factor(Model, levels = c("Full", "Linear")), Method)
}


# STUDY 2 - EQUATION ETA4 TABLE (because it is general; eta5 would be the same)
conv_table_study2_eta4 <- create_apa_convergence_table_study2(results_study_2, "eta4")

tab_caption_study2_eta4 <- "Convergence and Outlier Statistics (Simulation 2)"
tab_note_study2 <- "Distr. = distribution of exogenous latent variables. Epsilon = distribution of measurement errors. Zeta = distribution of structural disturbances. N Conv. = number of replications that converged for this method. Conv. Rate = percentage of replications that converged (%). N Global Conv. = sample size after requiring all methods to converge. N Outliers = number of outliers detected for this method. Outlier Rate = percentage of converged cases flagged as outliers (%). N Final = final sample size after global outlier removal across methods."

kableExtra::kbl(

                "N Conv.", "Conv. Rate", "N Global Conv.",
                "N Outliers", "Outlier Rate", "N Final"),
  caption = tab_caption_study2_eta4,

) %>%
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(

  )) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(

  ) %>%
```
